title: Monorepo deployment pipeline
brief: Developer Productivity at Quillstone Software wants a page describing the deployment pipeline for the monorepo, as of 2026-10-10. Section titled "Pipeline diagram": a left-to-right flow with these nodes named exactly: "Pull Request", "Lint and Unit Tests", "Build Image", "Security Scan", "Deploy to Staging", "Smoke Tests", "Manual Approval", "Canary 10%", "Full Rollout", "Auto Rollback". Arrows: Pull Request to Lint and Unit Tests; Lint and Unit Tests to Build Image labeled "pass"; Build Image to Security Scan; Security Scan to Deploy to Staging labeled "no critical CVEs"; Deploy to Staging to Smoke Tests; Smoke Tests to Manual Approval labeled "pass"; Manual Approval to Canary 10% labeled "approved"; Canary 10% to Full Rollout labeled "healthy 30 min"; Canary 10% to Auto Rollback labeled "error rate above 1%". Section titled "Stage durations": a bar chart of median duration in minutes per stage: Lint and Unit Tests 7.5, Build Image 4.2, Security Scan 2.8, Deploy to Staging 3.1, Smoke Tests 5.6, Canary 10% 30, Full Rollout 12. Also a table of the same stages with columns Stage, Median (min), p90 (min): Lint and Unit Tests 7.5 and 13.4, Build Image 4.2 and 6.9, Security Scan 2.8 and 4.1, Deploy to Staging 3.1 and 5.0, Smoke Tests 5.6 and 9.8, Canary 10% 30 and 30, Full Rollout 12 and 18. Section titled "Rules" with a bulleted list: Manual Approval is required only for services tagged tier-1; Friday deploys after 15:00 local time are blocked; Auto Rollback pages the owning team.

edit.request: Insert an "Integration Tests" node between Deploy to Staging and Smoke Tests, and add it to the chart and the table with a median of 8.3 minutes and a p90 of 14.7 minutes.
